response.rationale: Both Malay answers are valid variety-specific terms for the same electric kitchen appliance. The English cue and sense align, the similar relation is appropriate, and no false-friend contrast is needed. The English loan “food processor” may also occur in both varieties but does not invalidate the proposed forms.
